def typed_class_diagnostics(probabilities,labels,kind,*,threshold=.5):
    size=gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES[kind]
    prediction=(probabilities[:,1]>=threshold).long() if kind=='BOOLEAN' else probabilities.argmax(-1)
    names=gevis_fast.TYPED_CRITERIA[kind]
    matrix=torch.bincount(labels*size+prediction,minlength=size*size).reshape(size,size)
    classes=[]; confusion=[]
    for cls,name in enumerate(names):
        support=int(matrix[cls].sum()); predicted=int(matrix[:,cls].sum()); tp=int(matrix[cls,cls])
        classes.append({'class_id':cls,'class_name':name,'support':support,'predicted_count':predicted,
                        'recall':tp/support if support else float('nan'),'precision':tp/predicted if predicted else float('nan'),
                        'f1':2*tp/(support+predicted) if support+predicted else float('nan'),'missing_in_split':support==0})
        for target,target_name in enumerate(names):
            confusion.append({'true_class':name,'predicted_class':target_name,'count':int(matrix[cls,target]),
                              'row_share':int(matrix[cls,target])/support if support else float('nan')})
    return classes,confusion


if EXPERIMENT_MODE=='integrated':
    INTEGRATED_ROWS=[]; TIMING_ROWS=[]; CLASS_ROWS=[]; CONFUSION_ROWS=[]
    for split,loaders in [('validation',INTEGRATED_NS['validation_loaders']),('test',INTEGRATED_NS['test_loaders'])]:
        preparation_started=__import__('time').perf_counter()
        cache=INTEGRATED_NS['prepare_integrated_cache'](loaders,split,pair_limit=INTEGRATED_CK['pair_limit'],policy=INTEGRATED_CK['policy'])
        prepare_seconds=__import__('time').perf_counter()-preparation_started
        rows,predictions=INTEGRATED_NS['integrated_report'](INTEGRATED_MODELS,cache,INTEGRATED_CK['calibration'],split); INTEGRATED_ROWS+=rows
        for method,prob in predictions.items():
            for kind in gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES:
                for variant in ('raw','validation_calibrated'):
                    calibration=INTEGRATED_CK['calibration'][method][kind]
                    adjusted=prob[kind] if variant=='raw' else (prob[kind].clamp_min(1e-8).log()/calibration['temperature']).softmax(-1)
                    threshold=.5 if variant=='raw' else calibration.get('threshold',.5)
                    classes,confusion=typed_class_diagnostics(adjusted,cache['labels'][kind],kind,threshold=threshold)
                    context={'split':split,'method':method,'answer_type':kind,'variant':variant}
                    CLASS_ROWS.extend({**context,**row} for row in classes); CONFUSION_ROWS.extend({**context,**row} for row in confusion)
        for method,model in INTEGRATED_MODELS.items():
            _,warm_latency=gevis_fast.predict_typed(model,cache)
            first_latency=next(row['ms_per_question_group'] for row in rows if row['method']==method)
            TIMING_ROWS.append({'split':split,'method':method,'cache_preparation_seconds':prepare_seconds,'first_evaluation_ms_per_three_type_group':first_latency,'warm_ms_per_three_type_group':warm_latency})
        for kind,size in gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES.items():
            for method,cls in INTEGRATED_CK['constants'][kind].items():
                prob=torch.zeros(len(cache['bank_index']),size); prob[:,cls]=1.
                INTEGRATED_ROWS.append({'split':split,'method':method,'answer_type':kind,'variant':'raw',**gevis_fast.typed_metrics(prob,cache['labels'][kind],cache['rewards'][kind],kind)})
            for step_id,step in enumerate(INTEGRATED_NS['encoders']):
                selected=cache['step_id']==step_id
                if not selected.any(): continue
                for method,prob in predictions.items():
                    INTEGRATED_ROWS.append({'split':split,'step':step,'method':method,'answer_type':kind,'variant':'per_step_raw',**gevis_fast.typed_metrics(prob[kind][selected],cache['labels'][kind][selected],cache['rewards'][kind][selected],kind)})
        del cache
    integrated_results=pd.DataFrame(INTEGRATED_ROWS)
    for kind in gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES:
        print({'answer_type':kind})
        display(integrated_results.loc[integrated_results.answer_type.eq(kind)&~integrated_results.variant.eq('per_step_raw')].style.hide(axis='index'))
    display(integrated_results.loc[integrated_results.variant.eq('per_step_raw')].style.hide(axis='index'))
    ce=integrated_results.loc[integrated_results.method.eq('GEVIS_CE')&integrated_results.variant.isin(['raw','validation_calibrated'])]
    ljr=integrated_results.loc[integrated_results.method.eq('GEVIS_CE_LJR')&integrated_results.variant.isin(['raw','validation_calibrated'])]
    effect=pd.DataFrame()
    if not ljr.empty:
        effect=ljr.merge(ce,on=['split','answer_type','variant'],suffixes=('_ljr','_ce'),validate='one_to_one')
        for field in ('balanced_accuracy','macro_f1','change_recall','false_alarm_rate','ordinal_mae','regret'):
            if field+'_ljr' in effect: effect[field+'_delta_ljr_minus_ce']=effect[field+'_ljr']-effect[field+'_ce']
        display(effect[['split','answer_type','variant']+[c for c in effect if c.endswith('_delta_ljr_minus_ce')]].style.hide(axis='index'))
    probability_columns=['split','method','answer_type','variant','accuracy','balanced_accuracy','macro_f1','nll','brier','expected_calibration_error','mean_confidence','mean_true_answer_probability','confidence_accuracy_gap','prediction_largest_share']
    display(integrated_results.loc[integrated_results.method.isin(INTEGRATED_MODELS)&~integrated_results.variant.eq('per_step_raw'),probability_columns].style.hide(axis='index'))
    class_results=pd.DataFrame(CLASS_ROWS); confusion_results=pd.DataFrame(CONFUSION_ROWS)
    for kind in gevis_fast.TYPED_SIZES:
        print({'per_class_and_confusion':kind,'zero_support':'unverified class; recall is NaN'})
        display(class_results.loc[class_results.answer_type.eq(kind)].style.hide(axis='index'))
        display(confusion_results.loc[confusion_results.answer_type.eq(kind)&confusion_results.variant.eq('raw')].style.hide(axis='index'))
    display(pd.DataFrame(TIMING_ROWS).style.hide(axis='index'))
    print({'training_seconds':INTEGRATED_CK['report']['fit_seconds'],'preparation_seconds':INTEGRATED_CK['preparation_seconds'],'paired_updates':INTEGRATED_CK['report']['paired_updates'],'calibration':INTEGRATED_CK['calibration']})
    print('Frozen Backbone text/semantic/numeric-pretraining metrics: separate from the current typed numeric experiment')
    display(pd.DataFrame(INTEGRATED_CK['backbone_text_metrics']).style.hide(axis='index'))
    display(pd.DataFrame(INTEGRATED_CK['backbone_semantic_metrics']).style.hide(axis='index'))
    display(pd.DataFrame(INTEGRATED_CK['backbone_grounding_metrics']).style.hide(axis='index'))
    semantic_by_type=INTEGRATED_CK.get('backbone_semantic_by_type',[])
    semantic_details=INTEGRATED_CK.get('backbone_semantic_diagnostics',{})
    if semantic_by_type: display(pd.DataFrame(semantic_by_type).style.hide(axis='index'))
    fixed_comparison=INTEGRATED_CK.get('backbone_semantic_fixed_comparison',[])
    if fixed_comparison:
        print('Old and new encoders evaluated on identical held-out questions; neither test nor audit selects models')
        display(pd.DataFrame(fixed_comparison).style.hide(axis='index'))
    for key in ('contrast_pairs','confusion'):
        if semantic_details.get(key): display(pd.DataFrame(semantic_details[key]).style.hide(axis='index'))
    print({'answer_kind':'deterministic answers to declared numeric question operations','probability_meaning':'confidence that GEVIS reproduces the declared answer, not probability of equipment fault','reward_optimization':INTEGRATED_CK.get('reward_optimization',True),'language':'STEP 2 semantic metrics are separate; unrestricted free-language understanding is not established','sample_unit':'sensor/scope questions; correlated rows are not independent wafer counts','deployment':'experimental candidate bundle; no runtime model replaced'})

if RUN_BOOLEAN_DIAGNOSTIC_VALIDATE:
    DIAG_RESULTS=[]
    for split,loaders in [('validation',DIAG_NS['validation_loaders']),('test',DIAG_NS['test_loaders'])]:
        cache=DIAG_NS['prepare_boolean_cache'](loaders,split,pair_limit=DIAG_CHECKPOINT['pair_limit'])
        models={'GEVIS_fusion':(BOOLEAN_FUSION,gevis_fast.boolean_fusion_logits),
                'numeric_probe':(NUMERIC_PROBE,lambda model,x,lengths:model(x,lengths))}
        for name,constant_class in [('always_no',0),('train_majority',DIAG_CHECKPOINT['train_majority_class'])]:
            def constant_logits(model,x,lengths,constant_class=constant_class):
                logits=torch.zeros((len(x),2),device=x.device); logits[:,constant_class]=1.
                return logits
            models[name]=(NUMERIC_PROBE,constant_logits)
        for method,(model,fn) in models.items():
            metrics,_=gevis_fast.evaluate_boolean(model,cache,fn)
            DIAG_RESULTS.append({'split':split,'method':method,**metrics})
        del cache
    diagnostic_comparison=pd.DataFrame(DIAG_RESULTS)
    display(diagnostic_comparison.style.hide(axis='index'))
    print({'interpretation':'numeric-proxy ability only; test has not been balanced',
           'if_numeric_probe_only_improves':'inspect GEVIS numeric fusion',
           'if_both_fail':'inspect input/target/optimization and class support',
           'if_GEVIS_improves':'then test LJR and free-language tasks separately',
           'no_positive_cases':'recall is NaN; positive detection cannot be judged',
           'training_reports':DIAG_CHECKPOINT['reports']})

                'f1':2*tp/(n+p) if n+p else np.nan,'prediction_abstentions':int(matrix[i,-1])})
            for j,name in enumerate(labels+['Withheld: unsupported predicted criterion']):
                CONFUSION_ROWS.append({'answer_type':row.answer_type,'actual_class':label,
                    'predicted_class':name,'count':int(matrix[i,j])})
